description: United States import duty lookup from the USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule: HTS codes matching a code prefix or keyword with general, special and column-2 rates, units, and the duty amount for a customs value in USD when the general rate is ad valorem. US tariff only; no VAT, no other countries. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
